blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawmakers are seeking to establish a National Children’s Nutrition Program that aims to address stunting among Filipino children through an expanded feeding program targeting learners in daycare centers and public schools. In a statement on Friday, Nov. 6, the Second Congressional Commission on Education (Edcom 2) noted that the Senate and House of Representatives have finalized the provisions of the proposed National Children’s Nutrition Act which will repeal the Masustansyang Pagkain para sa Batang Pilipino Act that earlier established the National Feeding Program for undernourished children.
